home.metaTitle: PeakNova | AI Agents, Automation & Custom Software

hero.headline: AI agents that do real work.
hero.subtext: We design and build AI agents, automations and custom software that fit how your company actually operates.

ai-agents.title: AI agents
ai-agents.sentence: Agents that answer customers, qualify requests, update your systems and hand off to a person when it matters.
examples: Messaging agents on WhatsApp, Instagram and email
Back-office agents that read documents and update CRM or ERP records
Internal assistants grounded in your own data

ai-solutions.title: AI solutions
ai-solutions.sentence: AI features inside your product or tools: search over your documents, classification, extraction and summarization, with evaluation and guardrails.

automation.title: Automation
automation.sentence: Processes that run without copy and paste: triggers, integrations and scheduled jobs, with retries, logs and clear ownership.
examples: Reminders, notifications and data sync between tools
n8n or custom workers, depending on scale

full-stack.title: Custom software
full-stack.sentence: Web platforms and SaaS products built for production: multi-tenant architecture, secure APIs, background workers and interfaces people enjoy using.

understand.label: Understand
understand.text: We map how work actually flows: who decides, where data lives, what breaks.

design.label: Design
design.text: We choose the smallest system that solves the problem, and where a person stays in the loop.

build.label: Build
build.text: We ship in short iterations to a real environment, with tests, logging and access control from day one.

run.label: Run
run.text: We monitor, measure and improve after launch. You own the code and the data.

product.headline: NoraMedi: the operating platform for clinics
product.text: A multi-tenant platform for dental clinics and clinic groups. Appointments, treatment, finance and patient messaging in one place, with AI that answers WhatsApp and Instagram at any hour.
product.pending: NoraMedi dashboard screenshot is not in the repo yet. Demo data only.

privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.text: Personal data is minimized. Where records must be kept, it is anonymized instead of deleted, and every sensitive action leaves an audit trail. Designed with GDPR and KVKK requirements in mind.

isolation.title: Tenant isolation
isolation.text: Every query is scoped to what the user may access, not to a default value in a token.

automation.title: Reliable automation
automation.text: Webhooks are idempotent, jobs retry with backoff, and failures are visible, never silent.

human.title: Human in the loop
human.text: Agents act within clear limits. When a case is ambiguous or urgent, a person decides.

diagram.label: Organization to clinic to domain records, with the API and the worker kept separate

crm.sentence: We also design and fix Salesforce and CRM platforms, and connect them to the AI and automation we build.

summit.headline: Have a process worth automating?
summit.sentence: Tell us how it works today. We'll reply with a clear next step.
